verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence describes a way to look up a filing's, application's, or case's processing status, publicly or after login. The nearby items are adjacent features, not status tracking: a transmission protocol printed at submission (elster-docs-8), retrieving a result letter or electronic notices once issued (elster-docs-5, elster-docs-14), and a server-availability status page (elster-docs-19), which covers system uptime rather than case status.
